passive.name: Cannot Stop It!
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

passive.name: Fleet Triumph
passive.text: After the wearer uses attacks or gets hit, additionally regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy. This effect cannot be repeatedly triggered in a single turn.

passive.name: Heir
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **10/12/14/16/18%** and regenerates 1 Skill Point when the wearer uses their Ultimate on an ally. This effect can be triggered once after every 2 uses of the wearer's Ultimate. When the wearer uses their Skill, the next ally taking action (except the wearer) deals **30/35/40/45/50%** more DMG for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Departure
passive.text: After entering battle, if an ally deals the same DMG Type as the wearer, DMG dealt increases by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

substatLine: SPD (Until breakpoint) > HP = DEF > EFF RES%

entries.name: Spectrum Beam
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Asta's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Meteor Storm
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **50%** of Asta's ATK to one designated enemy and further deals DMG for 4 extra times, with each time dealing Fire DMG equal to **50%** of Asta's ATK to a random enemy.

entries.name: Astral Blessing
entries.text: Increases SPD of all allies by **50** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Astrometry
entries.text:
Gains 1 stack of Charging for every different enemy hit by Asta plus an extra stack if the enemy hit has Fire Weakness.
For every stack of Charging Asta has, all allies' ATK increases by **14%**, up to **5** time(s).
Starting from her second turn, Asta's Charging stack count is reduced by **3** at the beginning of every turn.

entries.name: Miracle Flash
entries.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Fire DMG equal to **50%** of Asta's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Sparks
entries.text:
Asta's Basic ATK has a **80%** base chance to Burn the enemy target for **3** turn(s).
Burned enemies take Fire DoT equal to **50%** of DMG dealt by Asta's Basic ATK at the start of each turn.

entries.name: Ignite
entries.text: When Asta is on the field, all allies' Fire DMG increases by **18%**.

entries.name: Constellation
entries.text: Asta's DEF increases by **6%** for every current Charging stack she possesses.

entries.name: Star Sings Sans Verses or Vocals
entries.text: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time to a random enemy.

entries.name: Moon Speaks in Wax and Wane
entries.text: After using her Ultimate, Asta's Charging stacks will not be reduced in the next turn.

entries.name: Meteor Showers for Wish and Want
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Aurora Basks in Beauty and Bliss
entries.text: Asta's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by 15% when she has 2 or more Charging stacks.

entries.name: Nebula Secludes in Runes and Riddles
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Cosmos Dreams in Calm and Comfort
entries.text: Charging stack(s) lost in each turn is reduced by 1.
